title: Descent of exact completed evaluation through scalar localization
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme $X$ and either its global pro-etale site or an actual over-site $U$. Use the completed coefficient ring $\mathcal R$, ambient derived category $D_U$, coefficient object and scalar action of [def-sf-raw-rational-slice-coefficients], the completed tensor and Hom of [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], and the completeness predicate of [def-weil-derived-complete]. Put $\Phi_M(L)=R\mathcal Hom(L,\mathcal R)\widehat\otimes^L M$ and $\Psi_M(L)=R\mathcal Hom(L,M)$. Give the scalar localization $q:D_U\to D_U[1/\varpi_E]$ the structure of [lem-weil-linear-scalar-localization-triangulated]: its shift by one is the scalar-localized integral shift, the comparison for $q$ there is the identity, and distinguished triangles are exactly triangles isomorphic to integral images. Let $M\in D_U$. Assume $\Phi_M,\Psi_M$ additive, $\mathcal O_E$-linear and triangulated with chosen coherent integer-shift comparisons. For every shift-compatible natural transformation $\alpha:\Phi_M\to\Psi_M$ there exist triangulated functors $F,G:D_U[1/\varpi_E]^{op}\to D_U[1/\varpi_E]$, comparison isomorphisms $e_F:q^{op}F\simeq\Phi_Mq$, $e_G:q^{op}G\simeq\Psi_Mq$ and a shift-compatible $\alpha_Q:F\to G$ with $(q^{op}\alpha_Q);e_G=e_F;(\alpha q)$. No completeness, evaluation formula or isomorphism-locus closure is used.

source.place: First paragraph, exact functors and preservation of direct summands; rational evaluation proof Steps 8; Stacks derived.tex, proposition-construct-localization (05R6).

proof.text: By [def-weil-linear-scalar-localization], a morphism in $\mathcal T[1/t]$ is a fraction $Q(f)/t^n$. For $F=\Phi,\Psi$, set $\overline F(L)=F(L)$ and $\overline F(Q(f)/t^n)=Q(F(f))/t^n$, reversing arrows. This is well defined: any equality of fractions becomes an integral equality after multiplication by a power of $t$, and Step 4 makes $F$ preserve that equality. Composition, identities and naturality of $Q\theta$ follow by the same fraction formula. The shift comparisons descend likewise. By [lem-weil-linear-scalar-localization-triangulated], every localized distinguished triangle is isomorphic to the image of an integral distinguished triangle. Step 4 sends the latter to a reversed distinguished triangle, so the descended functors are exact. Step 7 shows that $Q\theta$ is compatible with their shifts.

theorem completedEvaluation_rationalDescent
    [HasZeroObject (Rational l E X U)] [HasShift (Rational l E X U) ℤ]
    [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor (Rational l E X U) n).Additive]
    [Pretriangulated (Rational l E X U)] [IsTriangulated (Rational l E X U)]
    [(q l E X U).CommShift ℤ] [(q l E X U).IsTriangulated]
    (_hshift : shiftFunctor (Rational l E X U) (1 : ℤ) =
      ScalarLocalization.map (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E) (D l E X U)
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E) (shiftFunctor (D l E X U) (1 : ℤ)))
    (_hQshift : ∀ L : D l E X U,
      HEq (((q l E X U).commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app L)
        (𝟙 ((q l E X U).obj ((shiftFunctor (D l E X U) (1 : ℤ)).obj L))))
    (_htriangles : ∀ T : Triangle (Rational l E X U),
      T ∈ distTriang (Rational l E X U) ↔
        ∃ T' : Triangle (D l E X U), T' ∈ distTriang (D l E X U) ∧
          Nonempty (T ≅ (q l E X U).mapTriangle.obj T'))
    (M : D l E X U)
    [(phi l E X U M).Additive] [(psi l E X U M).Additive]
    [(phi l E X U M).Linear (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)]
    [(psi l E X U M).Linear (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)]
    [(phi l E X U M).CommShift ℤ] [(psi l E X U M).CommShift ℤ]
    [(phi l E X U M).IsTriangulated] [(psi l E X U M).IsTriangulated]
    (α : phi l E X U M ⟶ psi l E X U M) [NatTrans.CommShift α ℤ] :
    ∃ (F G : (Rational l E X U)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Rational l E X U)
            (eF : (q l E X U).op ⋙ F ≅ phi l E X U M ⋙ q l E X U)
            (eG : (q l E X U).op ⋙ G ≅ psi l E X U M ⋙ q l E X U)
            (sF : F.CommShift ℤ) (sG : G.CommShift ℤ),
            (fun [fShift : F.CommShift ℤ] [gShift : G.CommShift ℤ] ↦
              F.IsTriangulated ∧ G.IsTriangulated ∧
              ∃ αQ : F ⟶ G,
                NatTrans.CommShift αQ ℤ ∧
                Functor.whiskerLeft (q l E X U).op αQ ≫ eG.hom =
                  eF.hom ≫ Functor.whiskerRight α (q l E X U))
              (fShift := sF) (gShift := sG)
